subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding the basics of how owning income-generating assets (rental property, a small business, dividend investments) differs from trading time for money
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches an income source to whether it requires ongoing personal time (a job) or comes from an owned asset
exercise.abstract: Student explains the basic difference between earning money by trading time and earning money from an owned asset

misconception_flags: treats all forms of income as requiring the same ongoing personal time investment
